product.description: Premium credit card including Qantas Points on eligible purchases and access to concierge services wherever you are in the world

eligibility.additionalInfo: You must be an Australian citizen or permanent resident

features.additionalInfo: Our Platinum Visa Credit Card offers all the things you'd expect from a premium credit card including Qantas Points on eligible purchases and access to concierge services wherever you are in the world.
Unlimited electronic transactions available on your account
Unlimited free electronic transactions available on your account

Earn 1.00 Qantas Point for every $1 spent, and also 1 additional Qantas Point for every $1 spent on selected Qantas products and services in Australia (capped at 20,000 Qantas Points per month). Supplementary 10,000 bonus Qantas Points applied annually.
Get faster payments between participating banks, anytime with a Pay ID

Concierge is an exclusive service designed to assist platinum cardholders. It   s like having your own personal assistant available 24 hours, 7 days a week in Australia and overseas. Access to range of services including, Emergency travel arrangement provisions, Passport, visa, and customs information Translation and message assistance, Restaurant recommendations, concert tickets and tour bookings
Securely lock your debit card in the GCMB App while you look for it and unlock it again when you find it
Find the digital version of your card via the Mobile App before your physical card arrives in the mail.
A range of security features and services provided, including fraud prevention technology and secure banking, to help keep your funds safe.
Make free deposits and withdrawals through a Bank@Post facility at Australia Post outlets.
Minimum monthly repayment is the greater of 3% of the amount of the closing balance, or $20
With PayTo, you can see, review and authorise all new PayTo payments for transactions such as recurring bills, memberships and subscriptions before the money leaves your account.
